features.name: is_advanced_ai_trial
features.description: Indicates if the trial explicitly mentions advanced AI techniques like machine learning or deep learning.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to easily split on trials utilizing more complex AI methodologies.

features.name: trial_complexity_score
features.description: An additive score representing the structural complexity of the trial based on randomization, blinding, and international scope.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single continuous-like feature summarizing trial rigor, which trees can split at various thresholds.

features.name: ai_evidence_interaction
features.description: Interaction between the real-world deployment score and the evidence strength score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the synergistic effect of having both high real-world applicability and strong evidence, saving the tree from having to approximate this multiplication.

features.name: global_scale_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for trials conducted in more than one country.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a clean binary split for multi-national trials, which often have different operational characteristics.

features.name: tech_stack_diversity
features.description: Counts the number of distinct technology types mentioned (software, mobile app, wearable).
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse technology mentions into a denser ordinal feature for more effective tree splits.

features.name: vulnerable_population_included
features.description: Flags trials that include either children or older adults.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups specific demographic inclusions into a broader category of vulnerable populations.

features.name: rigorous_design_flag
features.description: Indicates if a trial is both randomized and blinded.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly models the logical AND of two key trial design elements, providing a direct split for high-quality trial designs.

features.name: ai_safety_privacy_focus
features.description: Flags trials that explicitly mention safety, privacy, or bias in the context of their AI application.
features.expected_model_benefit: Consolidates ethical and safety concerns into a single feature, reducing sparsity.

features.name: phase_enrollment_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between trial phase and enrollment size buckets.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model identify large, late-stage trials versus small, early-stage trials using a single continuous feature.

features.name: high_evidence_late_phase
features.description: Flags trials that are in phase 3 or higher and have an evidence strength score above 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct boolean split for mature trials with solid evidence backing.

features.name: semantic_commercial_viability
features.description: Assesses the likelihood that the trial's AI application has direct commercial viability based on the disease area, AI use type, and real-world deployment score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced, non-linear relationships between clinical domain and technology readiness that are hard to express via simple formulas.

features.name: semantic_regulatory_readiness
features.description: Evaluates the trial's readiness for regulatory submission based on evidence strength, safety mentions, and trial phase.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic assessment of regulatory maturity, offering a powerful continuous feature for tree splits.
